Appraiser remarks
Front-end damage is consistent with a low-speed head-on impact, with the bumper cover, hood leading edge, and
both headlamp assemblies showing crushing and cracks. The radiator support and upper crossmember appear bent,
though it is not yet clear whether every component listed was damaged in this event or some was affected earlier. No
prior damage to the vehicle is known to this writer. The proposed plan replaces the cover, hood, and lamps,
straightens the support, and refinishes the affected panels. The labor hours requested match the scope of visible
damage, and the invoices received show no repeated charges for the same operation.
